title: openai-responses-seed-determinism-metadata-passthrough-v6: passthrough seed/determinism and metadata for Responses API variants
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: New OpenAI Responses API variants expose seed/determinism flags and expect arbitrary request metadata to be passed through to model adapters. To maintain compatibility and preserve deterministic behavior for downstream customers we must: 1) accept and forward 'seed' and 'deterministic' (or 'temperature=0' equivalent) flags in the OpenAI-compat layer, 2) preserve arbitrary 'metadata' and 'user' fields through streaming and non-streaming code paths, and 3) ensure function/tool-calling and structured-output modes continue to work when these fields are present. This PR implements passthrough handling in the responses adapter, stabilizes streaming event framing so metadata is consistently attached to emitted chunks, and adds end-to-end tests across SDK adapters (python/ts) plus regression tests for previously observed non-determinism in canary workloads. Description below is a single continuous string per repo conventions.

feat(streaming): attach request metadata to streaming events and stabilize chunk ordering
fix(func-calling): preserve metadata when invoking tool calls via compat layer

docs: document new fields and upgrade notes in openai-compat.md
chore: update type hints and add compatibility shims for older models

redwood-sdk-typescript/openai_compat.ts: expose seed and deterministic in TS wrapper; add streaming metadata types

tests/unit/test_streaming_metadata.py: unit tests for streaming event metadata preservation

redwood-console/alerts/alert_rules.json: tweak alert thresholds for streaming error rate (temporary during rollouts)
scripts/compat_migrations/upgrade_hint_v6.md: guidance for customers relying on metadata passthrough

merge_details: squash and merge by Priya Nair on 2026-02-24 (merge_commit: squash, PR was linearized for release)
release_notes: [openai-compat] Responses API: passthrough 'seed' and 'deterministic' flags; metadata is preserved through streaming and tool-calling paths. SDKs updated (python/ts) to expose these flags. See docs/openai-compat.md for migration notes.
upgrade_guide: Customers that previously relied on implicit deterministic behavior should explicitly set 'seed' or 'deterministic=true' in their Requests to guarantee repeatability. Streaming clients should expect a 'x-rdwd-metadata' event header in streaming frames (backward shim present).
rollback_plan: Revert to previous compat adapter commit and disable new streaming header via feature-flag; alerting is in place to catch regressions. Backout tested on canary cluster within 30 minutes.
notes_on_performance: Benchmarking on canary with synthetic chat workload shows <1% p50 latency regression and ~2% p99 improvement for small-input deterministic paths due to KV-cache stability tweaks.
footnotes: This PR consolidates several community requests for OpenAI Responses parity (seed/determinism + metadata passthrough). Follow-up planned to surface deterministic testing helpers in the public SDKs.
